chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"The first person for whom a bier was made was Fatimah, the daughter of Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family."

key_terms.النَّعْشُ: the bier or funeral carriage upon which the deceased is carried
key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ: Fatimah عليها السلام, the daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مُحَمَّدٍ: Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: Who was the first person for whom a bier was made according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Fatimah bint Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله was the first person for whom a bier was made. It highlights a historical detail connected to the funeral rites and distinction of Sayyidah Fatimah عليها السلام within the family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
